notes.subject: תשגלנה
notes.rationale: šagel here and in parallel passages is the plain Hebrew verb for sexual intercourse — baphetoleli ba bantši ba e fihla ka go 'go nyatša'; Sepedi e bolela taba ka go tlwaela.

notes.subject: ירטשו
notes.rationale: Go robegwa ka maoto — go tlhagolela tlhogo; lentšu la Sepedi le boloka sebopego sa go thuntšha ka maatla.

translation: Masea a bona a tla robegwa pele mašemong a bona; malapa a bona a tla hlotlwa, gomme basadi ba bona ba tla šomišwa ka go nyaka.

tokens.gloss: ba tla šomišwa ka go nyaka
